name: Headless World Characters
features: Load enabled autonomous character records through the normal TrinityCore Player::LoadFromDB pipeline without a client socket
Insert headless players into Map and ObjectAccessor
Attach existing AutonomousPlayerAI and external AI controller
Start and stop all enabled headless bots
WoW addon controls for start/stop headless bots
core_integration: src/server/game/Handlers/CharacterHandler.cpp receives a small bridge using the existing LoginQueryHolder
important: Use dedicated accounts for headless characters; do not log the same account in interactively while its character is active.
